question: Does choosing high-information interventions produce measurable gain over a matched seeded-random policy, and what is provably non-identifiable when each unseen action-effect bit is independent?

source.reuse: NKR14 already examined 12 unfamiliar Boolean worlds and NKR13 already examined 12 positive-conjunction worlds, deterministic source-safe regression only
source.initial_actions: both 0 and 1 at all 8 initial contexts; exactly 16 events
source.new_actions: only action=1 at a selected cold context; reveal source outcome only after selection
source.source_refs: source labels and refs content-addressed to public records; NEVER contain world id or hidden operator label

unrestricted_track.prior: all arbitrary 16-bit Boolean action-effect truth tables plus a separately stated action-zero parity assumption
unrestricted_track.policy: all unseen action-effect bits contribute exactly 1 bit of information; deterministic active policy chooses smallest remaining context
unrestricted_track.random: SHA256 of canonical initial source bytes, policy name and probe round to select one of sorted remaining contexts; seed fixed in code and prereg
unrestricted_track.conclusion: Expected TIE with random for number of new known effect bits; neither policy may infer the other 4 unseen effect values without structural prior. Each selected outcome is DIRECTLY OBSERVED, never counted as transfer prediction.

structured_track.prior: all fifteen 4-bit positive conjunction masks consistent with initial observed paired interventions
structured_track.active: maximize exact binary entropy of observed action effect across current candidate masks; tie lowest context; even if zero entropy, preserve two-action budget
structured_track.random: same SHA256 deterministic seeded random policy under same two-action budget
structured_track.strong_control: independently implemented exact symbolic entropy policy using same public evidence; its choices and candidate updates must match native active on all worlds
structured_track.metric: after two actions, score exact consensus predictions on the remaining SIX unprobed action=1 cold contexts, not on actions already queried; report correct/covered/wrong/abstained for both policies

experimental_threshold.structured_positive: >=4 additional correct safe UNPROBED predictions across 12 worlds for active vs seeded random, zero confident errors, exact fully fitted independent symbolic parity; if less, preserve null NO_ACTIVE_ADVANTAGE
experimental_threshold.unrestricted: both policies source-exact 256->16 full Boolean functions, 4 public outcomes per world, 4 effect bits unknown per world, zero invented cold outcomes
experimental_threshold.retention: original previously learned warm source unchanged 32/32 per world (384/384 each track)
experimental_threshold.state: all SHA-pinned public intervention receipts cold-restorable, reject replay/wrong target/outcome source kind and no causal owner writes

acceptance.final: mandatory entire root regression and inherited NKR05 six tests, independent G29 both OS exact final SHA/tree
acceptance.science: no scientific promotion from reused synthetic cohorts or control tie
